description: Guest code verification: correct code opens a session; wrong, expired and exhausted codes are refused.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: "123456".
cases.log: Audit row GuestVerified (no actor; object GuestSession; details { meetingId, guestInvitationId }); session row added.
preconditions: Open invitation I1 (meeting Published) with latest challenge K1, code "123456", created 2 minutes ago, not consumed, 0 failed attempts.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult success with GuestVerified { accessToken, expiresAt = now + 12 hours, meetingId, profileCompleted: false }; K1 is marked consumed and one guest session row is created.
GuestAccessResult Failure(InvalidInvitation) (MSG371); no challenge is read.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: "123456".
preconditions: No challenge was ever created for I1.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: <correct code>.
preconditions: The latest challenge expires at exactly the current time (15 minutes after creation).
cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(InvalidCode) (MSG126): a code whose expiry is not later than now is refused.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: <even the correct code>.
preconditions: The latest challenge already has 5 failed attempts.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: <correct code>.
cases.log: Error log "Could not verify a code for guest invitation {InvitationId}."
preconditions: Saving the session fails with a persistence error.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(Unavailable) (MSG374); no session is created.

precondition: Guest invitation with a pending verification code.
